title: Command feedback and refusals
current: Outside hook guard deny text, Python refusals in the engine, CLI, contracts and harness use yoke_contracts.refusal_recovery.compose_refusal. The shared composer keeps the reason separate from a reachable recovery or escalation owner. Source tests reject new hand-written recovery labels; permanent migration history, standalone versioned Pack scripts, the relay entrypoint before package binding and the browser-only schema-skew reply retain their distinct source constraints. Registry-routed commands report path_argument_unusable when an OSError names an argv path (including the path before a pytest node id). The refusal names the errno and a bounded argument preview; whitespace adds a hint to pass paths separately. Errors naming internal paths still propagate.
